traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and named requirements in docs/stories/008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX.story.md are implemented and verified. The require-story-annotation rule provides ESLint --fix behavior to insert missing @story annotations for functions and methods using a safe, configurable template, with the ability to disable auto-fix via an option. The valid-annotation-format rule provides safe, suffix-only normalization of @story paths, with a corresponding autoFix toggle. Both behaviors are covered by dedicated tests in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts (plus broader tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts), all of which pass in the full test run. Documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md accurately describes the auto-fix capabilities, configuration options, scope, and safety constraints. There are no uncovered requirements or failing tests related to this story, so the implementation is considered complete for this specification.
